```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Mw.gmm: scalar for a flat magnitude, or a named vector keyed by TRT
# for scenario-linked magnitudes (e.g. c(ASC = 7.7, SCC = 5.5, SIF = 9)).
# No shared ephemerals here: knitBlock children run in the global env
# and rm() the canonical names (AUX et al.).
SiteID <- .cleanTarget(.currentTarget("siteID.target"))
StemPrefix <- if (length(SiteID) == 1L) paste0(tolower(SiteID), "-") else ""
Title <- if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Ground Motion Models"
for (Trt in sort(unique(GMPETable$TRT))) {
  Mw.target <- if (!exists("Mw.gmm", inherits = FALSE)) 6.5 else if (is.null(names(Mw.gmm))) Mw.gmm[[1L]] else if (Trt %in% names(Mw.gmm)) Mw.gmm[[Trt]] else 6.5
  FillColor <- unname(.TrtColors[[Trt]])
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## <br>%s\n\n", sub("(?=<br>|$)", sprintf(" (%s)", Trt), Title, perl = TRUE)))
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/GMPE.qmd",
    stem = paste0(StemPrefix, "gmm-", tolower(Trt), "-att"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      ID.target = unique(GMPETable[TRT == Trt, ID]),
      Mw.target = Mw.target,
      fillColor = FillColor
    ),
    root = root
  )
}
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "Trt", "FillColor", "Mw.target", "SiteID", "StemPrefix", "Title"
), ls()))
rm(list = intersect(c("ID.target", "p.target"), ls()))
```
